title: Chart
description: Render bar, horizontal bar, stacked bar, line, area, stacked area, pie, doughnut, scatter or radar charts from data, with an optional title.
author: Harald Bregu

title.description: Optional heading. Omit when no title is needed or the user asks for a chart without a title.

data.description: Rows of data. Each row has the xKey field and one number per series key.

xKey.description: Field for category labels, slice names or radar axes. Scatter charts require a numeric xKey field.

series.description: Numeric fields to plot. Pie and doughnut use only the first series.
